# Load required libraries
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

# Set your Visual Crossing API Key
api_key <- "API_KEY_HERE"

# Function to get weather data from Visual Crossing API
get_weather_data <- function(lat, lon, date, time, api_key) {
  # Convert date from DD-MM-YYYY to YYYY-MM-DD
  date <- as.character(date)
  formatted_date <- paste(substring(date, 7, 10), substring(date, 1, 2), substring(date, 4, 5), sep="-")
  formatted_time <- substring(time, 1, 8)
  if (substring(time, 10, 11) == "PM") {
    hour <- substring(time, 1, 2)
    hour <- as.numeric(hour)
    hour <- hour + 12
    hour <- as.character(hour)
    formatted_time <- paste0(hour, substring(time, 3, 8))
  }
  
  # Build API URL
  location <- paste0(lat, ",", lon)
  url <- paste0("https://weather.visualcrossing.com/VisualCrossingWebServices/rest/services/timeline/",
                location, "/", formatted_date,
                "?key=", api_key, "&include=hours")

  # Fetch data
  response <- GET(url)
  
  if (http_status(response)$category != "Success") {
    warning(paste("Failed to fetch weather for", date, time, "at", lat, lon))
    return(c(NA, NA, NA))
  }
  
  data <- content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  parsed <- fromJSON(data, flatten = TRUE)
  
  # Extract hourly data for the day
  hourly_data <- parsed$days$hours[[1]]
  
  # Convert time to 24-hour format to match API response
  time_24h <- strptime(time, "%I:%M:%S %p")
  time_24h <- strftime(time_24h, format = "%H:00:00")
  
  # Find the matching hour
  matching_row <- hourly_data[format(strptime(hourly_data$datetime, "%H:%M:%S"), "%H:%M:%S") == time_24h, ]
  
  if (nrow(matching_row) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No matching hour found for", date, time, "at", lat, lon))
    return(c(NA, NA, NA))
  }
  
  # Extract temperature, humidity, and precipitation
  temperature <- matching_row$temp
  humidity <- matching_row$humidity
  precipitation <- matching_row$precip
  dew <- matching_row$dew
  windspeed <- matching_row$windspeed
  windgust <- matching_row$windgust
  winddir <- matching_row$winddir
  pressure <- matching_row$pressure
  cloudcover <- matching_row$cloudcover
  solarradiation <- matching_row$solarradiation
  solarenergy <- matching_row$solarenergy
  uvindex <- matching_row$uvindex
  conditions <- matching_row$conditions
  
  return(c(temperature, humidity, precipitation, dew, windspeed, windgust, winddir, pressure, cloudcover, solarradiation, solarenergy, uvindex, conditions))
}

# Load your dataset (repo root, or this file's folder)
clean_path <- "data/processed/ECOLI_CLEAN.csv"
out_path <- "data/processed/ECOLI_W_API.csv"
if (!file.exists(clean_path)) {
  clean_path <- file.path("..", "..", "data", "processed", "ECOLI_CLEAN.csv")
  out_path <- file.path("..", "..", "data", "processed", "ECOLI_W_API.csv")
}
my_data <- read.csv(clean_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(my_data)

my_data <- subset(my_data, 
                  !is.na(SAMPLE_DATE) & 
                  !is.na(SAMPLE_TIME) & 
                  !is.na(LATITUDE) & 
                  !is.na(LONGITUDE))

# Optionally, you could also remove empty string cases if your dataset has them
my_data <- subset(my_data,
                  SAMPLE_DATE != "" & 
                  SAMPLE_TIME != "" & 
                  LATITUDE != "" & 
                  LONGITUDE != "")
head(my_data)

# Add columns for all the weather data
my_data$TEMPERATURE <- NA
my_data$HUMIDITY <- NA
my_data$PRECIPITATION <- NA
my_data$DEW <- NA
my_data$WINDSPEED <- NA
my_data$WINDGUST <- NA
my_data$WINDDIR <- NA
my_data$PRESSURE <- NA
my_data$CLOUDCOVER <- NA
my_data$SOLARRADIATION <- NA
my_data$SOLARENERGY <- NA
my_data$UVINDEX <- NA
my_data$CONDITIONS <- NA

# Loop through rows to fetch weather data
for (i in 1:nrow(my_data)) {
  cat(sprintf("Fetching weather data for row %d of %d...\n", i, nrow(my_data)))
  
  lat <- my_data$LATITUDE[i]
  lon <- my_data$LONGITUDE[i]
  date <- my_data$SAMPLE_DATE[i]
  time <- my_data$SAMPLE_TIME[i]
  
  weather_data <- get_weather_data(lat, lon, date, time, api_key)
  
  # Assign weather data to the appropriate columns
  my_data$TEMPERATURE[i] <- weather_data[1]
  my_data$HUMIDITY[i] <- weather_data[2]
  my_data$PRECIPITATION[i] <- weather_data[3]
  my_data$DEW[i] <- weather_data[4]
  my_data$WINDSPEED[i] <- weather_data[5]
  my_data$WINDGUST[i] <- weather_data[6]
  my_data$WINDDIR[i] <- weather_data[7]
  my_data$PRESSURE[i] <- weather_data[8]
  my_data$CLOUDCOVER[i] <- weather_data[9]
  my_data$SOLARRADIATION[i] <- weather_data[10]
  my_data$SOLARENERGY[i] <- weather_data[11]
  my_data$UVINDEX[i] <- weather_data[12]
  my_data$CONDITIONS[i] <- weather_data[13]
}

# Save enriched dataset
dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(my_data, out_path, row.names = FALSE)

cat("Weather data added and saved to", out_path, "\n")
